_comment_network: Replace [HUB_IP] with the private IP of your JupyterHub server.
_comment_auth: Set your team domain and admin usernames here. Admins get full cross-user session access.
_comment_mapping: Path to the JSON fallback mapping file (used if SQLite DB is unavailable).
_comment_db: Path to the SQLite state DB. Stores team→VM mappings and live per-user session state.
